nodes.name: Server
nodes.description: SSR runtime and build-time prerendering layer

nodes.name: SSR Server
nodes.description: React Router server that runs loaders and renders HTML

nodes.name: Root Layout Loader
nodes.description: Prefetches categories query via QueryClient.prefetchQuery(categoriesQueryOptions) and dehydrates the cache into SSR HTML for client hydration

nodes.name: Home Loader
nodes.description: Fetches full category list via fetchQuery, then prefetches first page of category sections via prefetchInfiniteQuery (4 categories per page, 4 products each)

nodes.name: Products Loader
nodes.description: Prefetches first page of products (limit 8, skip 0) for the selected category via prefetchInfiniteQuery; dehydrates cache for hydration

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.description: Client-side application shell, pages, and interactive components

nodes.name: App Shell
nodes.description: Root component that creates a singleton QueryClient via useState, initializes dark theme class on mount via useThemeStore.getState(), wraps children in QueryClientProvider, and renders the Toaster (sonner) for toast notifications

nodes.name: Root Layout
nodes.description: Receives dehydratedState from loader, wraps children in HydrationBoundary for TanStack Query cache rehydration, renders Header and Outlet

nodes.name: Header
nodes.description: Sticky header (top-0 z-10) with backdrop-blur, renders NavMenu (left), Logo (center), Cart drawer and ThemeToggle (right)

nodes.name: Nav Menu
nodes.description: Radix Sheet (side=left) listing first 10 categories as links, with a Collapsible overflow for remaining categories. Auto-closes on navigation via useNavigation().state === 'loading'

nodes.name: Cart Drawer
nodes.description: Radix Sheet overlay showing cart items with +/- quantity controls (CartItem sub-component), item count badge, running total, and checkout link. Renders EmptyState when cart is empty

nodes.name: Theme Toggle
nodes.description: Button that toggles between dark and light themes. Uses Sun/Moon lucide icons with CSS rotate/scale transitions for the icon swap animation

nodes.name: Pages
nodes.description: Route-level page components

nodes.name: Home Page
nodes.description: Renders 'Featured Categories' heading and infinite-scroll grid of CategorySection components. Uses react-intersection-observer (useInView) to detect sentinel visibility and trigger fetchNextPage. Each CategorySection shows 4 product cards in a horizontal scroll with a 'See More' link

nodes.name: Products Page
nodes.description: Paginated product grid (2/3/4 columns responsive) with category breadcrumb, page title from URL slug. Uses 'Load more' button (not infinite scroll) to fetch next 8 products. Shows end-of-list message when no more pages

nodes.name: Checkout Page
nodes.description: Order summary (items, subtotal, 20% VAT, total) with ShippingForm (name, email, address, city, postal) and PaymentForm (card number, expiry MM/YY, CVV). clientLoader guards empty cart with redirect to /products. clientAction simulates 1s delay, calls cart.clear(), sets successfulOrder flag, toasts success, redirects to /success. Submit button shows spinner via navigation.state === 'submitting'

nodes.name: Success Page
nodes.description: Order confirmation page with CheckCircle icon, hardcoded order number #134145, and 'Continue Shopping' link. clientLoader guards against direct access by checking successfulOrder flag (redirects to /products if false), then resets the flag. Fires js-confetti on mount with cleanup on unmount

nodes.name: Shared Components
nodes.description: Reusable presentational components used across pages

nodes.name: Product Card
nodes.description: Card with aspect-square product image (hover scale-110 transition), title (truncated), price, and full-width 'Add to cart' button. Calls onAddToCart prop and fires toast.success('Product added to cart') on click. Also exports ProductCardSkeleton for loading states

nodes.name: Data Layer
nodes.description: State management, data fetching, and external API integration

nodes.name: Client State
nodes.description: Zustand stores persisted to localStorage

nodes.name: Cart Store
nodes.description: Zustand store with persist middleware (key: 'cart-storage'). State: items (CartItem[]), total (number), successfulOrder (boolean). Actions: addItem (upserts by product.id, increments count if exists), removeItem, incrementItem, decrementItem (auto-removes at 0), clear. All mutations recalculate total via reduce

nodes.name: Theme Store
nodes.description: Zustand store with persist middleware (key: 'theme-storage'). State: theme ('dark' | 'light' | 'system'). setTheme removes existing light/dark class from documentElement, resolves 'system' via matchMedia('prefers-color-scheme: dark'), adds resolved class

nodes.name: Server State
nodes.description: TanStack Query hooks for API data with SSR prefetch and hydration

nodes.name: Categories Query
nodes.description: queryOptions with key ['categories'], fetches GET /products/categories returning Category[]. Used by root layout loader (prefetch), nav-menu (category links), and category-sections-query (page slicing). Shared across SSR and client

nodes.name: Category Sections Query
nodes.description: infiniteQueryOptions with key ['category-sections']. Each page slices 4 categories from the full list (pageParam * 4), fetches products for each via parallel Promise.all with an 800ms artificial delay. Returns { categoryProducts, nextCursor }. Enabled only when categories data is available

nodes.name: Products Query
nodes.description: infiniteQueryOptions with key ['products', category]. Fetches GET /products (or /products/category/:slug) with select=title,images,price,id, limit=8, skip=pageParam. getNextPageParam returns null when skip + products.length >= total

nodes.name: API Client
nodes.description: Ky HTTP client instance with prefixUrl 'https://dummyjson.com'. No timeout, retry, or error interceptors configured. Used by all server-state query hooks

nodes.name: External
nodes.description: External APIs and services

nodes.name: DummyJSON API
nodes.description: REST API at dummyjson.com providing product catalog and category data. Endpoints: GET /products/categories, GET /products/category/:slug, GET /products. No authentication required. No SLA or rate limiting documented

state.name: localStorage (Zustand persist)
state.description: Cart items array with product data (id, title, price, images) and quantities, total price, successfulOrder flag

state.name: TanStack Query in-memory cache
state.description: Categories list (key: ['categories']), category section products (key: ['category-sections']), product listings keyed by category (key: ['products', category])

state.name: TanStack Query dehydrate/hydrate
state.description: Serialized query cache embedded in SSR HTML for client hydration via HydrationBoundary

failure_modes.trigger: DummyJSON API becomes unreachable or returns 5xx
failure_modes.impact: Storefront shows empty pages. Cart and checkout still work for previously added items since cart state is in localStorage, not API-dependent.

cascade.effect: Ky HTTP requests fail with network or server error. No retry or timeout configured -- ky defaults apply (no retry for GET in this config, no explicit timeout)
Query enters error state, no category data available. TanStack Query will retry 3 times by default with exponential backoff
Cannot load category products. Additionally, depends on categories-query data (enabled: !!categories), so stays disabled if categories fail
Cannot load product listings for any category
Category navigation shows no category links (categoriesQuery.data is undefined)
No category sections rendered, only skeleton loading state
No products rendered, skeleton cards shown indefinitely

detection: TanStack Query error state surfaces in UI (though no explicit error UI is rendered -- components just show empty/skeleton)
SSR loader throws, triggering the root ErrorBoundary which shows 'Oops! An unexpected error occurred'
recovery: TanStack Query automatic retry (3 attempts with exponential backoff by default)
TanStack Query refetch on window focus (default behavior)
User can manually refresh the page to re-trigger SSR loaders

failure_modes.trigger: Browser localStorage unavailable (private browsing in some browsers, quota exceeded, storage disabled by user)
failure_modes.impact: Cart and theme reset on page refresh. Shopping session is ephemeral but fully functional within a single page session.

cascade.effect: Zustand persist middleware fails silently (persist middleware catches storage errors internally); cart works in-memory only for the session
Theme preference not persisted across sessions; reverts to 'system' (the default initial value) on each page load

detection: No detection implemented -- Zustand persist middleware swallows storage errors silently
recovery: Zustand stores fall back to in-memory state automatically
Cart data exists for the duration of the browser tab
Theme defaults to 'system' which respects OS preference via matchMedia

failure_modes.trigger: Server-rendered HTML diverges from client hydration due to stale prefetched data or timing differences between server and client renders
failure_modes.impact: Momentary flicker of stale content before fresh data loads. No data loss or functional impact.

cascade.effect: Dehydrated query cache in HTML payload contains data from server fetch time
React 19 hydration mismatch warning in browser console
Brief content flash as TanStack Query re-fetches and replaces stale cache entries on mount

detection: React hydration mismatch console warning in browser DevTools
recovery: TanStack Query re-fetches on mount by default, replacing stale entries transparently

failure_modes.trigger: DummyJSON API responds slowly (>3s) during SSR loader execution
failure_modes.impact: Shopper sees blank page or browser loading indicator for extended period. No timeout or fallback configured in the ky client or in the loaders. The 800ms artificial delay in category-sections-query compounds with slow API responses.

cascade.effect: Loader awaits all prefetch promises without timeout. Home loader fetches categories then N category product pages sequentially in Promise.all
Time to First Byte increases proportionally to API latency. No streaming SSR configured -- entire HTML waits for all loaders

detection: Increased TTFB observable in browser network panel or server-side performance monitoring
recovery: Request eventually completes or browser's own connection timeout fires
No automatic retry or timeout configured in ky client instance
No loader timeout configured in React Router

data_flows.name: SSR Home Page Prefetch
data_flows.description: Server prefetches categories and first batch of category products, dehydrates into HTML for instant client load

steps.action: Creates new QueryClient, calls prefetchQuery(categoriesQueryOptions) which GETs /products/categories
steps.data: QueryClient with cached Category[] (id, slug, name, image)

steps.action: Creates its own QueryClient, calls fetchQuery(categoriesQueryOptions) to get category list, then prefetchInfiniteQuery for first page (categories 0-3, 4 products each via parallel Promise.all + 800ms delay)
steps.data: Category list + first 4 category product arrays

steps.action: Ky GETs /products/categories and /products/category/:slug?select=title,images,price,id&limit=4 for each of the first 4 categories
steps.data: HTTP GET requests (5 total: 1 categories + 4 category products)

steps.action: Returns JSON responses with category list and product arrays
Calls dehydrate(queryClient) to serialize the prefetched query cache into a transferable state object
steps.data: Dehydrated query cache (serialized categories + category-sections queries)
steps.technology: SSR HTML payload (embedded in route loader data)

steps.action: QueryClientProvider creates client-side QueryClient. Root layout's HydrationBoundary rehydrates dehydrated state into the client cache
steps.data: Rehydrated TanStack Query cache with categories and first page of sections

steps.action: useCategorySectionsInfiniteQuery returns cached data immediately (no loading state). Renders CategorySection for each of the 4 categories with their product cards. IntersectionObserver sentinel placed after last section for scroll pagination
steps.data: React DOM: 4 CategorySection components, each with 4 ProductCards + 'See More' link

data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Shopper
    participant RRServer as React Router Server
    participant RootLoader as Root Layout Loader
    participant HomeLoader as Home Loader
    participant ApiClient as Ky API Client
    participant DummyJSON as DummyJSON API
    participant Browser as Browser (App Shell)
    participant HomePage as Home Page

    Shopper->>RRServer: GET /
    RRServer->>RootLoader: Execute loader
    RootLoader->>ApiClient: prefetchQuery(['categories'])
    ApiClient->>DummyJSON: GET /products/categories
    DummyJSON-->>ApiClient: Category[]
    RRServer->>HomeLoader: Execute loader
    HomeLoader->>ApiClient: fetchQuery(['categories'])
    ApiClient->>DummyJSON: GET /products/categories
    DummyJSON-->>ApiClient: Category[]
    Note over HomeLoader: Slice categories[0..3]
    HomeLoader->>ApiClient: Promise.all + 800ms delay
    ApiClient->>DummyJSON: GET /products/category/:slug x4
    DummyJSON-->>ApiClient: { products: Product[] } x4
    Note over HomeLoader: dehydrate(queryClient)
    HomeLoader-->>RRServer: { dehydratedState }
    RRServer-->>Browser: SSR HTML with dehydrated cache
    Browser->>HomePage: HydrationBoundary rehydrates cache
    Note over HomePage: Renders 4 CategorySections from cache
    HomePage-->>Shopper: Fully rendered home page

data_flows.name: Infinite Scroll Category Sections
data_flows.description: As the shopper scrolls down the home page, next batch of category sections loads
data_flows.trigger: Sentinel div enters viewport (IntersectionObserver via useInView)

steps.action: useInView ref detects sentinel in viewport (inView becomes true). Guard: only fires if !categorySections.isFetchingNextPage. Calls categorySections.fetchNextPage()

queryFn executes: slices next 4 categories from full list (categories[pageParam*4..(pageParam+1)*4]), fires Promise.all with 800ms artificial delay + parallel GET for each category's products (limit=4, select=title,images,price,id)
steps.data: 4 category slugs as URL params + pagination params

steps.action: Ky GETs /products/category/:slug?select=title,images,price,id&limit=4 for each of the 4 categories in parallel
Returns product arrays for each requested category
Maps responses to { id, slug, title, products } objects. Computes nextCursor: (pageParam+1)*4 < categories.length ? pageParam+1 : null. TanStack Query appends new page to infinite query cache

Re-renders with new CategorySection components appended. data.pages.flatMap renders all accumulated sections. If hasNextPage is true and not fetching, sentinel div is rendered for next trigger. CategorySectionSkeleton shown during fetch
steps.data: React DOM update: additional CategorySection components with ProductCards

data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Shopper
    participant HomePage as Home Page
    participant InView as IntersectionObserver
    participant CatQuery as Category Sections Query
    participant ApiClient as Ky API Client
    participant DummyJSON as DummyJSON API

    Shopper->>HomePage: Scrolls down
    InView->>HomePage: inView = true (sentinel visible)
    Note over HomePage: Guard: !isFetchingNextPage
    HomePage->>CatQuery: fetchNextPage()
    Note over HomePage: Shows CategorySectionSkeleton
    Note over CatQuery: Slice categories[n*4..(n+1)*4]
    CatQuery->>ApiClient: Promise.all(800ms delay + 4 fetches)
    ApiClient->>DummyJSON: GET /products/category/:slug x4
    DummyJSON-->>ApiClient: { products } x4
    ApiClient-->>CatQuery: Product[][] (4 arrays)
    Note over CatQuery: nextCursor = (n+1)*4 < total ? n+1 : null
    CatQuery-->>HomePage: Cache updated, re-render
    Note over HomePage: Append 4 new CategorySections
    HomePage-->>Shopper: New sections visible

data_flows.name: Add Product to Cart
data_flows.description: Shopper clicks add-to-cart on a product card; cart store updates, localStorage persists, drawer badge updates, toast confirms
data_flows.trigger: Click 'Add to cart' button on ProductCard

steps.action: handleAddToCart calls onAddToCart({ id, images, title, price }) prop and fires toast.success('Product added to cart')
steps.data: Product { id: number, title: string, price: number, images: string[] }

steps.action: addItem: checks if product.id exists in items[]. If exists: increments count. If new: appends { product, count: 1 }. Recalculates total via reduce(sum + item.product.price * item.count)
steps.data: Updated items[] array and recalculated total number

steps.action: Zustand persist middleware serializes { items, total, successfulOrder } to localStorage under key 'cart-storage'
Zustand subscription triggers re-render. Badge updates: cartItems.length shown in -top-1 -right-1 rounded-full span. If drawer is open, CartItem list updates with new/updated item
Sonner Toaster renders 'Product added to cart' success toast notification (auto-dismisses)

data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Shopper
    participant ProductCard as Product Card
    participant CartStore as Cart Store (Zustand)
    participant LocalStorage as localStorage
    participant CartDrawer as Cart Drawer
    participant Toaster as Sonner Toaster

    Shopper->>ProductCard: Click 'Add to cart'
    ProductCard->>CartStore: addItem({ id, title, price, images })
    Note over CartStore: Check if product exists in items[]
    alt Product exists
        Note over CartStore: Increment count
    else New product
        Note over CartStore: Append { product, count: 1 }
    end
    Note over CartStore: Recalculate total via reduce
    CartStore->>LocalStorage: persist('cart-storage', serializedState)
    CartStore-->>CartDrawer: Zustand subscription fires
    Note over CartDrawer: Badge count updates
    ProductCard->>Toaster: toast.success('Product added to cart')
    Toaster-->>Shopper: Success toast appears

data_flows.name: Checkout and Order Placement
data_flows.description: Shopper fills shipping and payment forms, submits order, cart clears, redirects to success page with confetti
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks 'Place Order' on checkout page

steps.action: clientLoader guard: reads useCartStore.getState().items.length. If 0, redirects to /products. Otherwise returns null to allow render
Renders OrderSummary (items, subtotal, 20% VAT, total), ShippingForm (name, email, address, city, postal code), PaymentForm (card, expiry, CVV). Submit button shows total in label
steps.data: Cart items and computed prices from useCartStore() hook

steps.action: Form submits via React Router clientAction. navigation.state changes to 'submitting', button shows Loader spinner and 'Placing order...' text

clientAction: awaits 1000ms setTimeout (simulated processing), then calls useCartStore.getState().clear() to empty cart, sets successfulOrder=true via setState, fires toast.success('Order placed successfully')
clear() sets items=[], total=0. Persist middleware writes to localStorage. successfulOrder flag persisted as true
steps.data: Cleared cart state serialized to localStorage

steps.action: clientAction returns redirect('/success') via React Router

clientLoader: reads useCartStore.getState().successfulOrder. If false, redirects to /products. If true, calls setState({ successfulOrder: false }) to reset flag (prevents revisiting). Returns null to allow render

Renders CheckCircle icon, 'Order Successful!' heading, hardcoded order #134145, 'Continue Shopping' link. useEffect creates JSConfetti instance and calls addConfetti(). Cleanup calls clearCanvas() on unmount

data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Shopper
    participant CheckoutPage as Checkout Page
    participant CartStore as Cart Store (Zustand)
    participant LocalStorage as localStorage
    participant Router as React Router
    participant SuccessPage as Success Page
    participant Confetti as JSConfetti

    Note over CheckoutPage: clientLoader guard
    CheckoutPage->>CartStore: getState().items.length
    alt Cart empty
        CheckoutPage->>Router: redirect('/products')
    end
    Shopper->>CheckoutPage: Fills shipping + payment forms
    Shopper->>CheckoutPage: Click 'Place Order'
    Note over CheckoutPage: navigation.state = 'submitting'
    Note over CheckoutPage: Button shows spinner + 'Placing order...'
    CheckoutPage->>CheckoutPage: clientAction executes
    Note over CheckoutPage: await setTimeout(1000ms)
    CheckoutPage->>CartStore: getState().clear()
    CartStore->>LocalStorage: persist empty cart
    CheckoutPage->>CartStore: setState({ successfulOrder: true })
    CartStore->>LocalStorage: persist flag
    Note over CheckoutPage: toast.success('Order placed successfully')
    CheckoutPage->>Router: redirect('/success')
    Router->>SuccessPage: Navigate
    Note over SuccessPage: clientLoader guard
    SuccessPage->>CartStore: getState().successfulOrder
    SuccessPage->>CartStore: setState({ successfulOrder: false })
    SuccessPage->>Confetti: new JSConfetti().addConfetti()
    SuccessPage-->>Shopper: Order confirmation + confetti

data_flows.name: Theme Toggle
data_flows.description: Shopper clicks theme button; store updates, DOM class toggles, preference persists, Tailwind dark: variants activate
data_flows.trigger: Click theme toggle button in header

steps.action: toggleTheme: reads current theme from useThemeStore(). If 'dark', calls setTheme('light'). Otherwise calls setTheme('dark'). Note: 'system' theme toggles to 'dark', not back to system

setTheme: removes 'light' and 'dark' classes from document.documentElement. If theme is 'system', resolves via matchMedia('prefers-color-scheme: dark'). Adds resolved class to root element. Calls set({ theme })
steps.data: Theme preference string + DOM classList mutation

steps.action: Zustand persist middleware serializes { theme } to localStorage under key 'theme-storage'
Zustand subscription triggers re-render. Sun icon (rotate-0 scale-100 / dark:-rotate-90 dark:scale-0) and Moon icon (rotate-90 scale-0 / dark:rotate-0 dark:scale-100) swap via CSS transitions

Tailwind dark: variant classes activate/deactivate across entire component tree based on 'dark' class on <html> element. All bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card etc. tokens respond to theme change
steps.data: CSS custom properties toggle (dark mode design tokens)
steps.technology: CSS (Tailwind dark mode via class strategy)

data_flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Shopper
    participant ThemeToggle as Theme Toggle
    participant ThemeStore as Theme Store (Zustand)
    participant DOM as document.documentElement
    participant LocalStorage as localStorage
    participant TailwindCSS as Tailwind CSS

    Shopper->>ThemeToggle: Click toggle button
    Note over ThemeToggle: Read current theme
    alt theme === 'dark'
        ThemeToggle->>ThemeStore: setTheme('light')
    else theme === 'light' or 'system'
        ThemeToggle->>ThemeStore: setTheme('dark')
    end
    ThemeStore->>DOM: classList.remove('light', 'dark')
    ThemeStore->>DOM: classList.add(resolvedTheme)
    ThemeStore->>LocalStorage: persist('theme-storage', { theme })
    ThemeStore-->>ThemeToggle: Subscription re-render
    Note over ThemeToggle: Sun/Moon icon swap animation
    DOM-->>TailwindCSS: dark: variants activate/deactivate
    TailwindCSS-->>Shopper: All colors update across app
